claims.claim: The Lower Capital Church and Avenue Balcony are connected by the Leyndell street/roof and canal route. The hazardous Avenue-to-Church drop is kept directional, while a separately sourced return route leads from the church back to Avenue Balcony.
Ranni's Chamber is the upper room grace inside Ranni's Rise. The return is the reverse local room route, and remains behind the same Ranni quest-start state used to expose the chamber grace.

After the Scaduview sealed Spiritspring is unblocked, guides document using the spring to return down toward Moorth Ruins. The return is modeled as a conditional vertical edge rather than an unconditional reverse of the ascent.
